# NeuromorphicPerspectiveEncoding

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method in neuromorphic hardware where perspective latents are represented as persistent neural activity patterns that modulate synaptic dynamics. Enables energy-efficient, real-time causal reasoning in iNEST by embedding perspective as a physical state, not just a computational variable.
